description: Search Google Flights for one-way or round-trip flights and emit one record per flight option.

airlines.description: Two-letter IATA airline codes — e.g. `["UA","DL"]`. Empty = all airlines.
airlines.title: Airlines allowlist (IATA)

country.description: Country code passed to Google Flights for regional pricing/availability.
country.title: Country (gl param)

currency.description: Currency code Google Flights should display (USD/EUR/GBP/...). The actor parses the displayed price using this currency.
currency.title: Currency (display)

directOnly.description: Alias for `maxStops=nonstop`. When true, drops connecting flights.
directOnly.title: Direct flights only

excludeAirlines.description: Two-letter IATA airline codes to exclude.
excludeAirlines.title: Airlines blocklist (IATA)

maxDurationMinutes.description: Drop flights whose total duration exceeds this many minutes.
maxDurationMinutes.title: Max total duration minutes

maxLayoverMinutes.description: Drop connecting flights with a layover longer than this. Ignored on nonstop searches.
maxLayoverMinutes.title: Max layover minutes

maxPrice.description: Drop flights above this price (in the chosen `currency`).
maxPrice.title: Max price

maxResults.description: Hard cap on emitted flight options.
maxResults.title: Max results

maxStops.description: Maximum stops on a single leg.
maxStops.title: Max stops

minPrice.description: Drop flights below this price (in the chosen `currency`).
minPrice.title: Min price

outboundDate.description: Outbound (departure) date. Defaults to 30 days from today when empty.
outboundDate.title: Outbound date (YYYY-MM-DD)

priceAlertThresholdUsd.description: When set, flights at or below this price get an extra `priceBelowThreshold: true` field.
priceAlertThresholdUsd.title: Price alert threshold USD

returnDate.description: Set for round-trip search. Empty for one-way.
returnDate.title: Return date (YYYY-MM-DD, optional)

useApifyProxy.description: Route through Apify's residential pool. Strongly recommended — Google Flights rate-limits cloud datacenter IPs aggressively.
useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify residential proxy

title: Google Flights Scraper Input
